candidate_windows.window_text: For the few-shot experiments, the QA pretrained models are fine-tuned with $1\%$ , $5\%$ and $10\%$ of the target domain data for 20 epochs. Other hyper-parameters are the same as in the QA training. We use 8 Tesla V100 GPUs for all of our experiments.
